messages:
Alex J: Quick async check on Calypso-4B onboarding for the model catalog launch. Need three things: legal signoff, perf profiles for seq=512 and seq=2048, and a canary window. PR is #4821 (model card + metadata). Who's blocking?

Maria S: Perf snapshot — quick notes: p95 token latency on g4dn for seq512 ~220ms, seq2048 p95 ~1.6s. INT8 helps bring seq2048 to ~1.0s but increases hallucination rate in our topical evals. Sharing perf table below.

Maria S: ```
env: g4dn.xlarge
model: calypso-4b (float32)
seq=512: p50 80ms, p95 220ms, throughput 65 tok/s
seq=2048: p50 310ms, p95 1600ms, throughput 22 tok/s
INT8: seq2048 p95 ~1000ms but hallucination delta +2.8% (on eval set)
```

Kevin L: License notes — upstream repo has Apache-2.0 but with an extra attribution clause in LICENSE.txt (Calypso-Labs clause). We need the exact LICENSE file in the PR and confirmation we can redistribute quantized weights. Also flag: export-control questionnaire required because Calypso-Labs is UK-based and uses certain encryption libs. I can draft the questionnaire but need a contact from infra.

Raja P: From product side: we need structured metadata (owners, allowed usage, rate limits), safety evals (toxicity, hallucination on our domain prompts) and clear pass criteria. Can we get those by EOD Friday? If not, we should delay canary.

Sarah P: Canary infra update — we have a hosted canary slot Wed 09:00-11:00 PST (limited QPS). Dedicated smoke can run Sat morning if you want a heavier load. Tagging @deploy-bot to schedule the hosted canary. Also need a short runbook for fallback (model variant + rollback).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2164010800 (Wed 09:00 PST). Reminder will be posted 30m before the window.

Maria S: Quick CR ping on PR #4821 — missing: dataset attribution section, perf artifacts (raw logs), and the eval notebook. @Alex J can you do a content pass on the model card text? Small edits.

Alex J: :thumbsup: I can review model card today and land the metadata fixes. Action items I see now: (1) Kevin -> upload LICENSE file + fill export-control Q by EOD; (2) Maria -> attach perf artifacts + eval notebook to PR; (3) Sarah -> confirm canary infra & add runbook to PR; (4) Raja -> post pass/fail checklist. If all green, we run canary Wed and aim GA next week.

Kevin L: Will upload LICENSE and draft the export-control answers, will ping here when done.

Raja P: I'll post a short pass/fail checklist in the PR now. Proposal: p95 latency <= 1s at seq512, hallucination rate < 5% on our topical eval set, and no safety regression on toxicity tests.

Maria S: Noted. If we tighten quantization to hit p95 targets we may need to re-run the evals — will do a quick re-run after Kevin uploads license so we have artifacts in the PR.

Alex J: Thanks everyone. If you hit any blockers drop a short update here. Will follow up after my review. :rocket:
